title: NASA Invites ISRO to Join Moon Base Programme Under Artemis Accords Framework
summary: NASA invited ISRO to join its Moon Base programme. India joined Artemis Accords in 2023 as 27th signatory (70 members currently).

blocks.content: NASA invited ISRO to join its Moon Base programme. India joined Artemis Accords in 2023 as 27th signatory (70 members currently).

items: **Global Invitation:** NASA invited ISRO to participate in its Moon Base exploration programme.
